Hermes setup, before-signing safety section, Use-when description

Version 1.4.5: FloorEscrow V3 live on Base (0x83818036539737a813D1D99f1c6Cd2867c7D6a6d), described next to V2. Contact trade@mentat.market. A2A get_quote returns 402 like REST. USDbC address checksum fixed.

Version 1.4.3: the name is MENTAT. The '(formerly FLOOR OTC)' tag is gone from the title and the description; the ClawHub section at the end is the only rename history (first published as floor-otc, that slug still redirects). No endpoint or skill changes.

Version 1.4.2: every endpoint now lives on api.mentat.market (A2A, REST, agent card, health) and MCP is served from the same host at /mcp (legacy SSE at /sse). Receipts and the public tape at mentat.market/ledger, with the read-only tape endpoints (/api/tape, /api/tape/{id}, /api/stats) listed. New section on the Hyperliquid price reference carried by every XMR quote and order (reference: perp_mark, spot_mid, depth_1pct_usd, depth_side, divergence_pct, observed_at; quote caps tier_max_notional_usd and depth_cap_usd; codes price_divergence, price_stale, price_unavailable; reference_warning on checks). execute_trade documents code execution_disabled. clawhub-skill.json gains price_reference and the new endpoints.

Version 1.4.1: documents the operator key. New SKILL.md section "What the operator key can and cannot do": the agent wallet 0xE6f2…bfd3 owns ERC-8004 Agent #31596 and is FloorEscrow's immutable treasury; it signs only createEscrow (gated on agent NFT ownership, moves no tokens), settle (permissionless payout to the addresses stored in the deal), and setAgentURI; it cannot withdraw, change the fee or treasury, pause, upgrade, amend a deal, or move a counterparty's tokens. Not used by quotes, the CoW relay, the XMR route, or MCP. clawhub-skill.json gains a machine-readable operator_key block. No endpoint or skill changes.

Version 1.4.0: MENTAT (formerly FLOOR OTC). Adds the XMR route via Wagyu: XMR/USDC on Base in both directions, XMR routed through XMR1 on Hyperliquid; Wagyu is the settlement counterparty, MENTAT never holds XMR, not trustless. Every quote and order response now carries settlement_path, route_legs, and proofs[] (one proof per leg, nothing inferred). New skills: create_xmr_order, check_xmr_order, get_route_status. 25 bps on every path; on the XMR route it is an integrator fee applied inside the Wagyu quoted amount (mentat_fee_bps, counted in effective_cost_bps). Amounts on the XMR route are decimal strings. Homepage mentat.market, contact desk@mentat.market.

Version 1.3.0 — Major update: CoW Protocol integration enables batched agent-signed swaps alongside existing escrow OTC.

- Added support for CoW Protocol relays: agents can now sign EIP-712 orders for instant, MEV-protected batch-auction settlement across Base liquidity.
- Introduced two swap paths: automated CoW batch trading for agents, or existing 1:1 on-chain escrow for OTC/human cases.
- New skills for CoW relay: `prepare_trade`, `submit_signed_trade`, and `check_cow_order`.
- Expanded documentation and examples for preparing, signing, and submitting agent trades via CoW.
- Protocol fee (25 bps) now applies to both settlement venues via native CoW partnerFee or on-chain escrow.
- Existing quote, trade, and price endpoints remain available; no authentication required.

- Added MCP (SSE) endpoint: `https://zesty-solace-production-13de.up.railway.app/sse`  
- No other functional changes detected.

floor-otc 1.1.0 changelog

- Updated on-chain escrow contract to V2 (`0x9EC9d882C93F52621CBD0d146D3F2e0929E53AA7`) with immutable protocol fee.
- New pricing model: zero spread, real CoinGecko rates; protocol fee of 25 bps (0.25%) applied to each side at settlement.
- Removed previous spread tiers.
- Documentation updates reflecting new pricing, contract details, and clearer skill descriptions.

- Initial release of FLOOR OTC, a trustless OTC escrow for token swaps on Base Mainnet.
- Provides live price quotes, trade execution through on-chain escrows, and trade status checking.
- Atomic settlement with no middleman or admin keys.
- Supports key tokens including USDC, USDbC, DAI, and WETH for escrow trades; additional tokens supported for quotes.
- Tiered trade spreads based on size; CoinGecko-based real-time pricing.
- Open REST and JSON-RPC (A2A) endpoints; no authentication required.
